financials.key_metric: Presence in 180+ countries, 1500 FI clients in clearing

overall_strategy_summary: Citi is undergoing a major transformation under CEO Jane Fraser, simplifying the organisation and investing heavily in technology. Key digital initiatives: Citi Token Services for cash (live in US, UK, SG, HK, Dublin), CIDAP enterprise platform, crypto custody launching 2026, stablecoin exploration (BVNK investment). Broader strategy: simplification programme, consent order remediation ($135.6M penalties in 2024 for data governance), Google Cloud AI partnership, wealth management growth, cross-border payments leadership, and 24/7 financial operations vision. Technology spend focused on modernisation, AI, and regulatory compliance.

business_segments.name: Services (TTS + Securities Services)
business_segments.description: Treasury and Trade Solutions (cross-border payments, liquidity, trade finance). Securities Services (custody, clearing, fund services). Citi Token Services live. 24/7 USD Clearing for 250+ banks, 40+ markets. Largest global FX clearer.

technology_strategy.ai_and_genai: Google Cloud AI partnership. Enterprise-scale AI deployment prioritised over research. 135.6M in penalties (2024) for data governance driving compliance-first AI approach. Agentic AI early R&D. AI for credit underwriting (60% processing time reduction potential).
technology_strategy.cloud: Google Cloud strategic partnership. Cloud-first approach for new applications. Legacy modernisation ongoing alongside consent order remediation.
technology_strategy.data_and_analytics: Data governance is critical priority (consent orders from 2020). CIDAP enterprise platform for digital assets data. Risk analytics and regulatory reporting modernisation.
technology_strategy.digital_assets: Citi Token Services live (US, UK, SG, HK, Dublin). CIDAP enterprise platform. Crypto custody launching 2026. BVNK investment. Stablecoin exploration. Multi-currency CTS (USD, EUR). Private permissioned blockchain. 24/7 USD Clearing integration.
technology_strategy.platforms: CitiDirect online banking portal. API platform for institutional clients. Global Payments network (1,500 FI clients). Treasury management platform.
technology_strategy.cybersecurity: Critical given consent orders and regulatory scrutiny. Data protection across 180+ countries.

operating_model.transformation: Major simplification programme under Jane Fraser. Consent order remediation ($135.6M penalties in 2024 for data governance gaps). Organisational simplification — exited 14 consumer markets. Focus on five core business lines. Technology modernisation across legacy infrastructure.
operating_model.outsourcing_signals: Building internally for digital assets ('can't just rent the technology' — Golenberg). Google Cloud partnership. 240K employees with significant global delivery footprint. Major technology operations in India, Ireland, Singapore.
operating_model.vendor_ecosystem: Google Cloud (AI partnership), BVNK (stablecoin infrastructure investment), Digital Asset (Canton Network indirect), technology services providers globally.
operating_model.key_metrics: ~$80B annual revenue. Presence in 180+ countries. 1,500 FI clearing clients. 250+ banks in 24/7 USD Clearing. 240K employees. Consent order remediation ongoing.

process.front_office: CTS for cash: 24/7 cross-border payments and liquidity management via tokenized deposits. No wallet or token holding required by clients - use CitiDirect or API. Crypto custody launching 2026.
process.middle_office: Third-party AML/monitoring software. Core ledger and token technology built in-house. Private permissioned blockchain. Same compliance standards as traditional assets.
process.back_office: CIDAP enterprise platform: internal blockchain, external blockchain connectivity, tokenization, custody, microservices. Private permissioned blockchain. Integration with 24/7 USD Clearing. SWIFT, API, and UI instruction channels.
process.operating_model_maturity: Production for CTS (billions processed). Crypto custody launching 2026. Semi-automated to industrialized.
process.regulatory_adaptation: US-focused with global reach. Active dialogue with regulators. OCC and SEC engagement. GENIUS Act awareness. MiCA awareness for Europe.
